Verify the business account, immutable artifacts, quota, pricing, resolved Runtime/GPU AMIs, subnet/VPC, and zero issue/run compute without mutation.

Apply one saved Terraform plan from the authorized exact source and inputs, retain its digest, prove real GPU model residency and separate Runtime/Guardian/six-agent ACC execution over the private Ollama route, destroy the stack, and verify zero residue within the authorized combined cost.

values.failure_policy: Fail closed before paid apply on any account, review, authorization, Terraform source/input, SSH /32/key, cost, deadline, artifact, quota, topology, lock, or stale-resource ambiguity. After apply, always attempt Terraform destroy and verify zero run instances and volumes; retain bounded failure evidence and never retry or fall back to another purchase path.
